description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Deepgram’s Partnerships team makes Deepgram the voice layer wherever businesses and developers build. As Dev Platform Partner Manager, you’d own our relationships with the platforms where the next wave of voice apps gets built, hosted and scaled: AI app builders, edge and inference clouds, and model routers. You’d also help grow the Deepgram Marketplace, our catalog of complementary voice AI services. There are a few live relationships and a lot of white space. You’d decide what gets built in it, and then build it.

What You Will Do:

  • Make Deepgram the default or recommended voice provider inside our highest-priority dev platforms, with commercial terms that hold up, working with Finance and Legal

  • Build and keep re-ranking a focused partner portfolio, putting time where developer reach, voice AI fit and revenue potential are highest

  • Shorten the path from a developer’s first click to paid usage by shipping integrations, templates, starter apps and docs with DevRel, Product and partner teams

  • Turn usage on partner platforms into Deepgram customers by spotting builders who are scaling and bringing Sales in at the right moment

  • Grow partner-sourced and influenced revenue, usage and attach, and be the source of truth on how the ecosystem is performing

  • Bring partner and developer insight back to Product so it shapes our SDKs, integrations and pricing

  • Support the Deepgram Marketplace: launch new partners, give Sales attach plays they’ll actually run, and flag the partner gaps customers are asking about

  • Build AI-native systems for partner research, account mapping, enablement and reporting, so one person covers the ground of a much larger team

We are looking for Someone who:

  • Has taken a partnership from first conversation to live launch and can show the usage or revenue that followed

  • Operates AI-native: designs Human+AI workflows for partnerships work and can show something they’ve built with AI tools

  • Builds systems that eliminate recurring partner work instead of re-solving it each time

  • Understands how developers discover, try and buy tools, and designs partner motions around that

  • Technical fluency to work through APIs, SDKs and integrations with partner engineers and DevRel

  • Ranks opportunities by impact and says no to partners that won’t move usage or revenue

  • Communicates clearly with partner executives and across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Legal

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, a technical field, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience

Bonus Points:

  • Typically ~5–8 years in partnerships, BD or ecosystem roles at developer-facing or AI companies, including as a founder or early operator, or equivalent demonstrated experience

  • Has closed reseller, marketplace or rev-share agreements, including pricing and billing terms

  • Experience in voice AI, speech, LLMs or real-time communications

  • Existing relationships at dev platforms, inference clouds or AI app builders

  • Experience with marketplaces, partner catalogs, or usage-based and PLG motions

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.
